name: Regex Builder
description: Assemble a regular expression from structured options with per-part explanations.

hints.parts: Tick the parts you need; the generator assembles them in a fixed order and explains each one.
hints.output: The result is validated against the RE2 flavour; invalid combinations such as an empty pattern are flagged.

faq.q: Can it generate any regular expression?
faq.a: No. It covers common fragments and does not handle nested quantifiers, backreferences or other advanced constructs.

faq.q: Are special characters in the prefix escaped?
faq.a: Yes. Regex metacharacters in the prefix and suffix are escaped and matched literally.
